name: Incubus Realms - Escapism
source:
"Trapped in a cell you must find a way out and possibly help the people you find along the way. Many paths and options are given to the player right from the start, none of them are wrong. During your adventure, you face the reality that no one in this world is being held against their will. In fact, your own desires are the real enemy here. The Incubus awaits you, he knows you can't resist his call..."

[From [url=https://ghuraok.itch.io/incubus-realms-escapism]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
「你被困在一間牢房中，必須設法逃出去，並儘可能幫助途中遇到的人。從一開始，玩家就有許多路線和選擇，沒有哪種選擇是錯誤的。冒險途中，你會逐漸發現，這個世界裡沒有人是被迫留下的。事實上，真正的敵人是你自己的慾望。夢魔正在等著你；他知道你無法抗拒他的召喚……」

[來源：[url=https://ghuraok.itch.io/incubus-realms-escapism]Itch.io[/url]]
